three.reuse: Exact previously verified local module bytes copied by build; per-file SHA256 recorded in build-receipt.json.

gsap.reuse: Existing local vendor; original license header retained. No new animation framework.

luma_wipe.author: gre
luma_wipe.adaptation: Renderer embeds its grayscale-mask blend in a Three.js ShaderMaterial; sampler names changed to fromImage/toImage. A screen-derivative smoothstep adds approximately one-pixel edge antialiasing to the original threshold. UV coordinates are never displaced. The fallback contour mask is original analytical code.

depth_anything.status: Optional externally prepared non-human-art depth textures only; no inference dependency in renderer.
depth_anything.restriction: Never depth-warp a literal photo layer. Other V2 model sizes have different, noncommercial weight licenses.

hyperframes.use: Pinned local composition check/preview/render CLI. Prototype check on integrated artwork passed with0 lint/runtime/layout/contrast errors; fullfilm check is separate.

adapted_existing_renderer.changes: Removed photo-card paths and procedural launch props; added source-coordinate subject keep-out FX, strict identity/depth/frame guards, focal-region framing, shared plane geometry and trimmed-audio duration binding.

subject_keepout.implementation: Original small inline GLSL shader in renderer.mjs; no additional package or copied upstream shader.
subject_keepout.effect_scope: Finite-timeline rain/light/water affect only background outside manually supplied subjectBounds with protective padding; face/body receive unchanged sample from the finished integrated source artwork.
subject_keepout.limits: This preserves the artwork during rendering; it is not a claim that image generation preserved original-photo pixels or exact personal likeness.
